scope: All completed coding-session generations, including compaction/thinking. Six uncounted backend qualification generations excluded.
method: Single sequential backend: partition server timing records by each alternating run relay count; reconcile all native agent records when no compaction occurred.
limitations: Backend prompt evaluation counts are computational work, not API billing usage. Native input/cache totals cover successful agent responses; failed/compaction API usage can be unknown.
If any request/task/usage failed to reconcile, this script would refuse a complete budget decision.
On model/provider-format errors, API usage may be unknown. Backend timings still count the generated output; normal request usage is individually cross-checked where available.
This supplements the recorder; it does not repair its compaction blind spot.
